# Introduction

Spearman correlation between total cavity volume (CAVTOT) and total lesion
glycolysis (TLG) across all paired treatment visits (W0, W4, W16, W24).  
All visits are included in a single plot to capture
the full range of imaging values across the treatment course. Spearman rho is
reported as a rank-based measure of monotonic association; a linear regression
line (OLS on log-transformed values) is overlaid to visualise the direction and
magnitude of the trend.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(writexl)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
#| label: file-paths

input_pet   <- "Input/PET.CT_long_SATVI.xlsx"
output_main <- "Output/Figure_S11A"

dir.create(output_main, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

pet_data <- read_excel(input_pet, sheet = 1) %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, Comments, CAVTOT, TLG) %>%
  mutate(
    Visit  = factor(paste0("W", Visit), levels = c("W0", "W4", "W16", "W24")),
    CAVTOT = log10(1 + as.numeric(CAVTOT)),
    TLG    = log10(1 + as.numeric(TLG))
  ) %>%
  drop_na(CAVTOT, TLG)

head(pet_data)
dim(pet_data)
cat("Visits present:", levels(pet_data$Visit), "\n")
cat("N participants:", n_distinct(pet_data$ID1), "\n")
cat("N observations:", nrow(pet_data), "\n")
```

# Compute Spearman correlation

```{r}
#| label: spearman-correlation

corr_test <- cor.test(
  pet_data$CAVTOT,
  pet_data$TLG,
  method = "spearman",
  exact  = FALSE        # exact = FALSE avoids warning with ties
)

spearman_rho <- round(corr_test$estimate, 3)
spearman_p   <- corr_test$p.value

cat(sprintf("Spearman rho = %.3f\n", spearman_rho))
cat(sprintf("P value      = %s\n",   format.pval(spearman_p, digits = 3)))

# Save correlation result
corr_result <- data.frame(
  Method      = "Spearman",
  Rho         = spearman_rho,
  P_value     = spearman_p,
  N_obs       = nrow(pet_data),
  N_subjects  = n_distinct(pet_data$ID1),
  Note        = "All visits pooled — repeated measures not independent"
)

write_xlsx(corr_result, file.path(output_main, "Figure_S11A_correlation_result.xlsx"))
print(corr_result)
```

# Scatter plot

```{r}
#| label: scatter-plot
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6

corr_plot <- ggplot(pet_data, aes(x = CAVTOT, y = TLG)) +
  geom_point(
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6,
    size  = 2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method  = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se      = TRUE,
    color   = "red",
    fill    = "red",
    alpha   = 0.15,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
  title    = "Correlation between paired CAVTOT and TLG across all visits",
  subtitle = sprintf(
    "Spearman rho = %.3f  |  %s  ",
    spearman_rho,
    ifelse(spearman_p < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", spearman_p)),
    nrow(pet_data)
  ),
  x        = "Total cavity volume (log10, mL)",
  y        = "Total lesion glycolysis (log10, mL)"
) +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.border      = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.grid.major  = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "solid"),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    axis.text         = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title        = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.caption      = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40", hjust = 0)
  )

print(corr_plot)
```

# Save plot

```{r}
#| label: save-output

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_main, "CAVTOT_TLG_correlation.pdf"),
  plot     = corr_plot,
  width    = 5.5,
  height   = 4
)

cat("Outputs saved to:", output_main, "\n")
```
